news.title: Jaipur development body pauses crackdown on illegal commercial units for 15 days
news.para: The Jaipur Development Authority has temporarily paused enforcement actions against more than six thousand illegal commercial units. This decision comes in light of tribunal interventions and directives from the Supreme Court mandating timely orders. The Authority is now awaiting further clarifications from the tribunal and forthcoming Supreme Court decisions.

news.title: Ratlam civic body evicts 208 flats in Dosi village amid protests
news.para: Officials initiated an eviction drive at Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana flats, citing illegal occupations as the reason. Families impacted by the removal attempted to protest against the sealing of their homes. After being denied the chance to submit their memorandum, residents marched towards the Collectorate. Former MLA Paras Saklecha voiced strong opposition, leading to a blockade of transport vehicles.

news.title: Grovy India raises ₹15 crore via preferential issue
news.para: Grov India has successfully raised Rs 15 crore through a preferential issuance.  Currently, Grovy is working on residential projects totaling approximately 183,000 square feet and has recently added new luxury developments. The company aims to ramp up its project execution to between 20 and 25 per year.

news.title: DLC rate hike to push up home costs in Rajasthan by over 20%
news.para: State government's increased DLC rates will make homes over twenty percent costlier for buyers. Buyers will face higher property prices and increased stamp duty charges. Developers state that higher land costs will be passed on to home buyers. The real estate sector anticipates a negative impact from these frequent rate adjustments.

news.title: Tamil Nadu government unveils affordable housing scheme for middle income families
news.para: Tamil Nadu's budget allocates Rs 8,852 crore for housing and urban development. A new 'My Home' scheme will build one lakh affordable houses over seven years. Redevelopment of ageing tenements will receive Rs 1253 crore for improvements. An AI-powered governance platform, SPEED, will expedite digital planning permissions. A master plan for the expanded Chennai Metropolitan Area is also being prepared.

news.title: Pune: PMC cautions property buyers against purchasing illegal constructions in merged areas
news.para: The Pune Municipal Corporation has issued a strong alert to homebuyers, urging them to exercise caution before buying properties without thorough research. Illegal multi-storey buildings in merged areas are facing potential demolition due to inadequate development plans. Permissions for construction are now contingent on the regional plan approved by PMRDA.

news.title: Maharashtra stamp duty revenue up 17% in first four months despite unchanged ready reckoner rates
news.para: Maharashtra's registration department saw revenue climb nearly seventeen percent in four months. This growth occurred as ready reckoner rates remained unchanged for the current financial year. Document registrations increased significantly, including more lease and rental agreements.  The department is confident in achieving its annual revenue target of sixty-eight thousand five hundred crore rupees.

news.title: YEIDA set to roll out residential plots scheme near Noida airport
news.para: The Yamuna Expressway Industrial Development Authority is gearing up to unveil two new residential plot schemes come October. One will cater specifically to the low-income group with 40 sqm plots available, while the general public can apply for larger plots, ranging between 162 to 300 sqm. The newly established eligibility criteria will bar prior allottees from participating.

news.title: Over 100 illegal structures to be razed in month-long drive in Gurugram
news.para: The Municipal Corporation of Gurgaon (MCG) will be tearing down more than a hundred unlawful constructions this month. Special task forces will carry out daily enforcement tasks citywide. Property owners are urged to self-rectify by removing any illegal segments before official action begins. Those who do not comply risk demolition and having costs recovered from them. MCG emphasizes its commitment to safe and lawful urban growth.

news.title: Shalimar Paints’ subsidiary to sell Gurugram property for ₹50 crore; Edelweiss' EAAA acquires office park in Pune
news.para: Shalimar Adhunik Nirman has finalized a deal to sell its property in Gurugram for Rs 50 crore, with Sparton Growth Comtrade set to receive payments in phases leading up to the registration of the sale deed. Concurrently, Edelweiss's alternatives division has made a strategic acquisition of an expansive office park in Pune, enhancing the fund's overall portfolio. Notably, the Pune property boasts an impressive occupancy rate of 95%.

news.title: About 3.30 lakh villages mapped under SVAMITVA scheme, ₹1,713 crore loans disbursed using property cards
news.para: Through the SVAMITVA Scheme, rural landowners gain property rights, enabling clear ownership demarcation that stems from advanced drone surveying technology. This approach not only curtails property disputes but also ensures rightful ownership records are established. Loans totaling more than Rs 1,713 Crore have been issued in connection with these property documents.

news.title: Delhi government proposes business reform bill; expected to ease licences, inspection rules
news.para: Delhi's proposed Ease of Doing Business Bill, 2026, will introduce self-certification for low-risk industries.  The legislation aims to eliminate multiple departmental approvals and streamline business registrations.  A single window system will consolidate all major business approvals and utility connections online.  Deemed approvals will be granted if authorities fail to decide applications within set timelines.

news.title: ASK Property Fund creates ₹500 crore platform with Bhumika group
news.para: ASK Property Fund and Bhumika Group have formed a Rs 500 crore platform arrangement. This partnership will focus on real estate developments, including residential plotted colonies. The fund has committed Rs 125 crore to a Faridabad plotted development project. Faridabad's infrastructure growth and affordability make it an attractive micro-market.

news.title: Madhuri Dixit sells two properties in Mumbai’s Andheri, Juhu for ₹9.2 crore
news.para: Madhuri Dixit has sold a commercial office in Andheri West and a residential apartment in Juhu for a combined Rs 9.25 crore. The deals reflect sharp appreciation in Mumbai's property market, with the Andheri office rising over nine-fold in value since 2008 and the Juhu flat more than doubling since its purchase in 2012.

news.title: Mindspace Business Parks REIT’s NOI rises 28% to ₹788 crore in Q1 FY27
news.para: Mindspace Business Parks REIT’s consolidated total income increased 28.4 per cent to ₹969.48 crore, while net profit rose 63 per cent to ₹271.81 crore. Its manager approved a distribution of ₹441.55 crore, or ₹6.67 per unit.

news.title: Brigade Hotel Ventures’ net profit rises 142% to ₹17.34 crore in Q1 FY27
news.para: Brigade Hotel Ventures’ consolidated total income increased 4.6 per cent to ₹130.83 crore during the quarter. Its board has appointed Vinay Gupta as chief executive officer with effect from August 17, 2026.

news.title: JK Lakshmi Cement’s net profit declines 28% to ₹108.07 crore in Q1 FY27
news.para: JK Lakshmi Cement's consolidated total income increased 8.9 per cent to ₹1,920.21 crore during the quarter. It is investing ₹3,000 crore to expand clinker and cement capacity at its Durg plant.

news.title: Berger Paints’ net profit rises 29% to ₹405.01 crore in Q1 FY27
news.para: Berger Paints' consolidated total income increased 12.2 per cent to ₹3,622.65 crore during the quarter. Higher crude-linked raw material costs led to some moderation in gross margins.

news.title: Smartworks leases 1.41 lakh sq ft in NCR; IWG opens four new Regus centres
news.para: Smartworks leased 1.41 lakh sq ft in Aerocity, Delhi, reporting strong revenue growth. The company has a significant secured footprint across India and Singapore. IWG opened four new Regus centers in Noida, Bengaluru, and Hyderabad. These additions expand IWG's flexible workspace network in India. IWG plans over 325 centers in India within three to five years.

news.title: Bhubaneswar civic body notice to 4,632 city homes over illegal commercial use
news.para: In a decisive move, Bhubaneswar Municipal Corporation has reached out to 4,632 homeowners potentially breaking regulations by running commercial enterprises from their residences. Each homeowner has a month to provide evidence of their property's usage. Failing to comply could lead to the sealing of properties marked unauthorized. The civic body has also submitted a report on these actions to the Supreme Court.
